Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Berlatar pada malam penyerbuan Jepang di Hong Kong, film tentang kisah cinta yang tragis produksi Shaw Brothers ini dibintangi oleh Li Ting dan Kwan Shan sebagai sepasang kekasih yang terpisahkan oleh perang.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Tu Meng-Fei menyelamatkan seorang murid wanita, Mu Wan-Erh, dan gadis lainnya, Li Sai-Nan, dari pemimpin dunia kriminal Leng Tien-Lei. Li ingin membalas dendam pada Leng yang membunuh orangtuanya.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: Seorang wanita cantik nan bodoh diculik oleh alien, tapi tak ada yang mempercayainya. Saat berencana bunuh diri demi membuktikan dirinya, ia bertemu dengan seorang detektif gagal yang juga berencana untuk bunuh diri.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star

programme.title: A Place To Call Home

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: Sebagai hukuman atas perilaku buruknya, putri Kaisar Jade yang ke-tujuh diusir dari surga dan dikirim untuk tinggal bersama manusia. Di sana, ia jatuh cinta dengan seorang pemuda desa bernama Dong Young.

programme.title: Clans Of Intrigue

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Ahli film laga Chang Cheh menceritakan kisah tentang Chin Feng yang bertemu dengan gadis cantik bernama Ting Hung saat tengah melarikan diri, setelah ia tak sengaja membunuh seorang pengganggu yang sombong.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: Peter Chen Ho adalah seorang playboy tampan yang mengencani tiga gadis kakak beradik, dan hal ini memicu serangkaian peristiwa konyol dan menghebohkan.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: Tiga pendekar kung fu dari latar belakang yang sangat berbeda menjadi murid Shaolin di kuil yang sama: Lo Lieh sang Pengawal Kerajaan, Lo Meng sang tentara yang melarikan diri, dan Wang Yu si pria desa.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Kisah ini bercerita tentang Lin Shao-teh, seorang mahasiswa miskin yang bertunangan dengan Chien-king, putri dari seorang miliarder bernama Wang Chun.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: Sebuah film fantasi-horor berlatar belakang Moskow masa kini, di mana masing-masing kekuatan yang mengendalikan siang dan malam saling bertempur.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung adalah seorang pemuda yang nakal namun saleh, tetapi setelah serangkaian insiden, ayahnya yang frustrasi menyuruh seorang guru bela diri mabuk untuk mendisiplinkannya.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun adalah seorang ahli bela diri terampil yang bertarung untuk membalas dendam atas kematian sang kekasih dengan bantuan dari seorang pemimpin geng pengemis.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Nona Qiao meninggal secara tak wajar dan kepala pelayannya membayar seorang perajin untuk membuat sebuah boneka kertas. Serangkaian peristiwa nan mengerikan terjadi saat arwah Nona Qiao bangkit untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Paman Hua adalah pensiunan agen yang memiliki toko barang antik di sebuah jalan tua. Namun, jalan itu dihancurkan secara paksa oleh Geng Naga Hijau setempat, dan membuat identitas Paman Hua tak sengaja terungkap.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang wanita berusia akhir dua puluhan yang menemukan kembali bakatnya dalam bertinju setelah lama absen. Secara tak terduga, ia bertemu dengan mantan pelatih tinjunya dan keduanya bekerja sama untuk membantunya mencapai babak final pertandingan tinju profesional.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming menyusupi kepolisian atas suruhan triad, sementara Yan adalah polisi yang menyamar sebagai anggota triad. Menjalani kehidupan ganda membuat keduanya merasa terjebak dalam kebohongan dan ingin mencari jalan keluar.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: Marbles, seorang anak berusia 10 tahun, menyaksikan pembunuhan seorang wanita muda.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah menarik tentang kerumitan dalam menciptakan anak, yang menampilkan penampilan komedi langka oleh Alex Man Chi Leung.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: Tahun 1917, Chen Zhen, yang diyakini telah meninggal, kembali ke Shanghai dengan nama palsu. Dia bergabung dengan seorang bos mafia untuk mendapatkan informasi tentang Jepang, termasuk daftar panjang orang yang ingin dibunuh, dan pada malam hari melawan orang-orang Jepang bertopeng.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Seorang playboy kaya tewas akibat diledakkan oleh seorang gangster ketika ia menggoda istri gangster tersebut. Melalui serangkaian kejadian, profesornya membuatkan tubuh sintetis yang memungkinkannya untuk berubah menjadi apa pun yang diinginkannya.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: The Champions : PL Goats
programme.desc: Will Perry is joined by Premier League winners Owen Hargreaves and Peter Schmeichel to discuss the best title-winning teams in the Premier League era. Expect insightful anecdotes, interesting archive and lively debate across a packed hour-long programme.

programme.title: Ep01 : PL Masterclass
programme.desc: Some of the Premier League's biggest stars take us onto the pitch to discuss the techniques and thought processes that allow them to perform at the highest level. Featuring Dan Burn, Dominik Szoboszlai, Ollie Watkins and Leeds United set pieces.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: Norwich, The Nearly Men : PL Stories
programme.desc: We take a trip down memory lane to revisit the incredible story of Norwich City's unforgettable 1992-93 season; the campaign that saw an unfancied side come within touching distance of becoming the first-ever Premier League champions. Through interviews with the players and staff who lived it, we relive the pressure, drama and defining moments of a nerve-shredding title battle with Manchester United that could have changed English football history forever.

programme.title: Coba-Coba Cintanya Bikin Terjaga-Jaga
programme.desc: kehidupan seorang pria bernama Ryan. Ryan adalah seorang duda beranak satu yang berjualan mainan keliling untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja ia bertemu dengan Rosa seorang gadis yang merupakan seorang selebgram terkenal. Suatu saat ketika anak Ryan yang akan menyebrang jalan dihampiri selebgram tersebut karena si gadis khawatir melihat anak kecil itu. Tanpa diduga, Ryan malam memvideokan aksi selebgram tersebut. Ryan menuduh si perempuan itu akan menculik anaknya. Rosa berusaha untuk melakukan pembelaan, tapi Ryan tidak mau mendengarkannya ia bersikukuh kalau Rosa akan menculik anaknya. Video yang dibuat oleh Ryan tersebut menjadi sangat viral di media sosial dan membuat citra sang selebgram menjadi turun. Oleh karena itulah, manager Rosa meminta Rosa untuk melakukan pendekatan kepada Ryan agar Ryan mau memberikan klarifikasi.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Undian Memang Salah Tapi Hasilnya Kita Berjodoh
programme.desc: Julia yang mengetahui akan segera dinikahkan dengan Bimo, nekat kabur dari rumah dengan menggunakan motor trail-nya.Julia meminta kepada sahabatnya yang bernama Iis untuk membantunya mengatur rekayasa selama ia dalam perjalanannya kabur. Bimo mengejar Julia dengan menggunakan mobil pickup terbuka. Bimo dan para temannya berteriak agar Julia menghentikan jalannya.

programme.title: Janji Gak Naksir Cewek Cleaning Glowing
programme.desc: Salsa (Soraya Rasyid) gagal liburan ke Korea lantaran keluarganya bangkrut mendadak. Untuk menopang finansialnya, Salsa terpaksa bekerja sebagai petugas kebersihan. Di tempat kerjanya, Salsa bertemu Al (Masaji Wijayanto) dan El (Jeremiah Rakesh), dua bersaudara yang sering berantem. Al dan El sama-sama naksir Salsa dan bersaing untuk bisa merebut hatinya. Bagaimana kisah selanjutnya? Saksikan selengkapnya hanya di FTV SCTV - Janji Gak Naksir Cewek Cleaning Glowing.

programme.title: Cegil Vs Cowok Soft Spoken
programme.desc: Dira (Diandra Agatha), seorang gadis yang memiliki sifat sangat cegil (cerewet/bawel) dan mudah panik atau ribet dalam berbagai situasi. Di sekolahnya, dia bertemu dengan Arya (Emyr Razan), seorang cowok yang sangat pendiam, lembut, dan soft spoken, kebalikan dari dirinya. Konflik muncul ketika Dira jatuh hati pada Arya, tapi sikapnya yang terlalu banyak bicara dan sering memaksa perhatian membuat Arya yang tenang justru makin menjauh.

programme.title: Queensbury Boxing League - Edge of Greatness
Greatest Classics S1, Ep 2
programme.desc: Setelah sepuluh tahun tidak bertanding, "Big" George Foreman kembali ke ring tinju pada bulan Maret 1987. Meskipun para kritikus mengatakan bahwa ia terlalu tua untuk bertarung secara serius di Kejuaraan Dunia lainnya, Foreman mulai meraih serangkaian kemenangan yang pada akhirnya menarik perhatian dunia.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Ortiz Vs Maidana
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah pertarungan antara dua atlet pencetak KO, saat Victor Ortiz, yang datang dengan delapan kemenangan KO beruntun, akan menghadapi Marcos Maidana, yang telah mencetak KO dalam 24 dari 25 kemenangannya. Pemenang dari laga ini akan dinobatkan sebagai juara sementara kelas welter ringan WBA.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo S32, Ep 5
programme.desc: Episode ini menampilkan pertarungan sumo dari Ryogoku Kokugikan, Tokyo, Jepang.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts S4, Ep 4
programme.desc: Menyoroti kejuaraan bela diri—baik turnamen sabuk, pertarungan tingkat internasional.

programme.title: Karate 1 Premiere League
programme.desc: Karate 1 – Premier League adalah rangkaian turnamen elit karate yang diselenggarakan oleh World Karate Federation.

programme.title: FS MMA: Sonnen Vs McKenzie
programme.desc: LEBIH BANYAK MMA SENIN: Superstar MMA yang blak-blakan, Chael Sonnen, bertanding dengan veteran Tim McKenzie dari Stockton, California. McKenzie memasuki pertarungan dengan rekor 10-3, setelah memenangkan dua pertarungan terakhirnya dengan TKO atas Doug Marshall dan Mike McGuinnes. Sonnen sedang berada di sela-sela tugasnya dengan UFC pada saat itu, setelah memenangkan dua pertarungan pertamanya dengan Bodog dan mengarah ke pertarungan ini. Dia akan menghadapi orang-orang seperti Anderson Silva, Jon Jones, dan Rashad Evans di UFC sebelum mengumpulkan kemenangan atas Rampage Jackson dan Wanderlei Silva dengan Bellator.

programme.title: Mega Fights In 60 S1, Ep 11
programme.desc: Mega Fights In 60 S1 adalah sebuah program dokumenter atau highlight show yang merangkum aksi-aksi penting dari pertarungan populer (baik tinju maupun MMA).

Meskipun para kritikus mengatakan bahwa ia terlalu tua untuk bertarung secara serius di Kejuaraan Dunia lainnya, Foreman mulai meraih serangkaian kemenangan yang pada akhirnya menarik perhatian dunia.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Ortiz Vs Maidana
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah pertarungan antara dua atlet pencetak KO, saat Victor Ortiz, yang datang dengan delapan kemenangan KO beruntun, akan menghadapi Marcos Maidana, yang telah mencetak KO dalam 24 dari 25 kemenangannya. Pemenang dari laga ini akan dinobatkan sebagai juara sementara kelas welter ringan WBA.

programme.title: FS MMA: Sonnen Vs McKenzie
programme.desc: LEBIH BANYAK MMA SENIN: Superstar MMA yang blak-blakan, Chael Sonnen, bertanding dengan veteran Tim McKenzie dari Stockton, California. McKenzie memasuki pertarungan dengan rekor 10-3, setelah memenangkan dua pertarungan terakhirnya dengan TKO atas Doug Marshall dan Mike McGuinnes. Sonnen sedang berada di sela-sela tugasnya dengan UFC pada saat itu, setelah memenangkan dua pertarungan pertamanya dengan Bodog dan mengarah ke pertarungan ini. Dia akan menghadapi orang-orang seperti Anderson Silva, Jon Jones, dan Rashad Evans di UFC sebelum mengumpulkan kemenangan atas Rampage Jackson dan Wanderlei Silva dengan Bellator.

programme.desc: Musim pertama Hidden Cities Extreme mengikuti Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk mencoba langsung pengalaman-pengalaman yang menantang sekaligus memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya setempat. Mulai dari mempelajari seni bela diri Eskrima di Filipina, mengikuti balap kerbau di Indonesia, hingga mencicipi makanan khas yang tidak biasa, setiap perjalanan menghadirkan sisi budaya yang autentik dan jarang terlihat oleh wisatawan. Dengan memadukan petualangan, tantangan ekstrem, dan eksplorasi budaya, serial ini mengajak penonton melihat Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

programme.title: Pionnier 1952
programme.desc: Pionnier 1952 mengisahkan sebuah misi investigasi yang berawal dari temuan bukti terkait Batalion Prancis, satuan infanteri yang dikirim ke Perang Korea di bawah naungan Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa pada tahun 1950. Setelah bergabung dengan Divisi Infanteri ke-2 Amerika Serikat, batalion ini berperan penting dalam sejumlah pertempuran besar, termasuk Pertempuran Arrowhead. Melalui penelusuran sejarah, eksplorasi medan perang, dan kesaksian berbagai pihak, dokumenter ini berupaya mengungkap nasib para prajurit yang tidak pernah kembali, sekaligus memberikan secercah harapan bagi keluarga mereka yang telah menantikan jawaban selama puluhan tahun.

Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: Tian Tian
programme.desc: Tian Tian

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Di desa, mereka berinteraksi dengan teman, tetangga, dan hewan-hewan sekitar, menyebabkan berbagai situasi canggung dan lucu yang tak berujung. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. Tiantian, sang anak yang berusia enam tahun, penuh dengan rasa ingin tahu dan cinta akan dunia, mulai berkembang menjadi pribadi yang sehat, mandiri, dan percaya diri di tengah keindahan pedesaan.

programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Sunny Girl
programme.desc: Sunny Girl

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Melalui diskusi bersama jurnalis, pengamat, akademisi, dan narasumber terkait, program ini menyajikan analisis yang komprehensif dan beragam sudut pandang untuk membantu pemirsa memahami perkembangan peristiwa secara lebih mendalam.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Just Eat
programme.desc: Just Eat mengajak para peserta melakukan perjalanan kuliner ke berbagai destinasi untuk menikmati beragam hidangan khas. Mereka mengunjungi restoran populer maupun tempat makan tersembunyi, berbincang dengan para koki dan masyarakat setempat, serta mengenal budaya yang membentuk cita rasa setiap masakan. Dipenuhi momen hangat, humor, dan pengalaman kuliner yang menggugah selera, program ini menghadirkan hiburan sekaligus wawasan tentang kekayaan budaya melalui makanan.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. programme.title: Heureusement Qu'On S'A
programme.desc: With his mother being treated in hospital for depression, 13 year-old Vincent has to take care of his younger brother and sister. He gradually comes to realise that his father is both egocentric and irresponsible, which means that Vincent can only count on himself to protect his family.

programme.title: HEUREUSEMENT QU'ON S'A
programme.desc: Vincent, remaja berusia 13 tahun, sangat mengagumi ayahnya yang gemar sepak bola dan bercita-cita menjadi pelatih profesional. Namun di balik sosok yang ia kagumi, sang ayah ternyata mengabaikan keluarga dan menyerahkan seluruh beban rumah tangga kepada istrinya. Ketika sang ibu mengalami kelelahan mental hingga mencoba mengakhiri hidupnya dan kemudian dirawat karena depresi, Vincent bersama adik laki-laki dan adik perempuannya berharap mendapatkan dukungan dari ayah mereka. Sayangnya, ayah mereka justru menolak mengambil tanggung jawab. Terpaksa menjadi tulang punggung keluarga di usia yang masih sangat muda, Vincent harus menjaga kedua adiknya sekaligus menghadapi kenyataan pahit tentang sosok ayah yang selama ini ia idolakan. Di tengah berbagai kesulitan, ketiga bersaudara itu menemukan kekuatan melalui kasih sayang dan solidaritas satu sama lain.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi
programme.desc: Legendary and highly recommended: L'Eclaireur, the concept store by Armand Hadida. All about the origins of the carat, the unit of measurement that governs the jewellery industry. Anicet: starting from what already exists and offering a new life to jewellery. Shorts and skirts: the elegant way to wear ultra-short hemlines.

programme.title: Le Petit Blond De La Casbah
programme.desc: Antoine returns to his native Algeria for the screening of his film about his childhood in Algiers in 1960. He wanders along the streets of Algiers with his son and recalls his happy childhood, the independence movements of the time and the birth of his passion for film.

programme.title: Le Petit Blond De La Casbah
programme.desc: Antoine returns to his native Algeria for the screening of his film about his childhood in Algiers in 1960. He wanders along the streets of Algiers with his son and recalls his happy childhood, the independence movements of the time and the birth of his passion for film.

programme.title: LE PETIT BLOND DE LA CASBAH
programme.desc: Sutradara ternama Antoine Lisner kembali ke kota kelahirannya, Aljir, bersama putranya yang seusia dirinya saat meninggalkan Aljazair pada tahun 1962. Saat mempersiapkan pemutaran film terbarunya, Antoine menelusuri kembali jalan-jalan yang pernah menjadi bagian dari masa kecilnya dan mengenang kehidupannya dalam komunitas Yahudi Aljazair pada masa-masa terakhir kolonialisme Prancis. Di tengah persahabatan, cinta pertama, kehangatan keluarga, dan tumbuhnya kecintaan terhadap dunia perfilman, Antoine juga menyaksikan perubahan besar yang terjadi akibat perjuangan kemerdekaan Aljazair. Diangkat dari kisah autobiografi Alexandre Arcady, film ini merupakan perjalanan emosional tentang identitas, kenangan, dan kerinduan terhadap tanah kelahiran.

programme.desc: Four little dinosaurs, Rocky, Bill, Tiny and Mazu, discover a dangerous world where the mysterious Gigantosaurus, the most ferocious of all the dinosaurs, is forever on the prowl. The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: L'Afrik En Contes
programme.desc: One day the lion decides to set a trap for the other animals in order to enjoy a feast. He pretends to be dead. All the animals gather to mourn his passing. But the hare, more intelligent than the others, prods the lion with a red-hot iron...

programme.title: L'AFRIK EN CONTES
programme.desc: L'AFRIK EN CONTES menghidupkan kembali dongeng tradisional Afrika melalui animasi penuh warna dan penceritaan yang menarik. Setiap episode menyampaikan pesan moral, humor, dan warisan budaya, memperkenalkan penonton muda pada tokoh-tokoh legendaris serta kebijaksanaan turun-temurun.

programme.desc: Lola is Simon's older sister, five years old, who lives in his head, cut off from the world. By observing him, she notices that he is very sensitive to everyday sounds. To communicate better with him, Lola builds a noise machine with her friend Rolih.

programme.title: LOLA ET LE PIANO À BRUITS
programme.desc: Lola adalah seorang anak yang memiliki kecintaan besar terhadap musik dan berbagai suara di sekelilingnya. Adiknya, Simon, adalah anak autistik yang memandang dan merasakan dunia dengan cara yang berbeda. Saat berusaha memahami sensitivitas serta cara berkomunikasi sang adik, Lola menemukan bahwa musik dapat menjadi jembatan yang menghubungkan mereka. Dengan bantuan sebuah “piano bunyi”, berbagai suara sehari-hari berubah menjadi melodi yang membantu mereka saling memahami. Film animasi yang hangat dan menyentuh ini mengangkat tema keluarga, autisme, empati, serta kekuatan musik dalam membangun hubungan antarmanusia.

programme.desc: Jeanne jatuh cinta kepada Jean, seorang pemuda pemberontak yang tidak pernah merasa nyaman dengan kehidupan yang dijalaninya. Ketidakmampuannya untuk menetap membuat Jean terus melarikan diri hingga akhirnya meninggalkan Jeanne tanpa penjelasan. Sementara Jeanne tetap menyimpan harapan dan mengenang hubungan mereka, Jean ternyata menemui akhir hidup yang tragis tanpa pernah diketahui oleh wanita yang mencintainya. Melalui kilas balik penuh nostalgia tentang masa-masa mereka di Provence dan Paris, film ini menghadirkan kisah cinta yang puitis, melankolis, dan menyentuh tentang kehilangan, kenangan, serta cinta yang tetap hidup meski orang yang dicintai telah tiada.

programme.desc: Diadaptasi dari kisah nyata dan buku karya Juliette Boudre, film ini menceritakan perjuangan seorang ibu untuk menyelamatkan putranya, Joseph, yang terjerumus dalam kecanduan obat-obatan resep seperti obat penenang dan opioid. Bersama keluarga, Juliette berupaya mencari berbagai cara untuk membantu Joseph pulih, mulai dari konsultasi medis hingga rehabilitasi. programme.desc: Seorang gadis sakit bernama Ju-ran pindah ke sekolah asrama sanatorium baru untuk memulihkan kesehatannya. Namun, ia menemukan bahwa para siswa menghilang dan memperhatikan perubahan abnormal yang terjadi pada tubuhnya. Ia mencoba mengungkap rahasia apa yang tersembunyi di baliknya.

programme.title: The Roundup: No Way Out

programme.title: Innocence
programme.desc: Seorang pengacara ternama mengungkap konspirasi sebuah desa kecil saat membela ibunya yang diasingkan karena menderita penyakit Alzheimer dan dituduh membunuh para pelayat di pemakaman suaminya.

programme.title: Hi-Five
programme.desc: Hi-Five mengisahkan lima orang biasa yang hidupnya berubah setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari donor misterius yang sama. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka menyadari bahwa transplantasi tersebut memberikan kemampuan luar biasa yang berbeda-beda pada masing-masing orang. Saat masih berusaha memahami kekuatan baru mereka, muncul seorang pria berbahaya yang ingin menguasai kemampuan tersebut demi ambisinya sendiri. Terpaksa bersatu meskipun memiliki latar belakang dan kepribadian yang berbeda, kelima tokoh ini menjalani petualangan penuh aksi, humor, dan tantangan untuk menghadapi ancaman yang mengincar mereka. Dengan nuansa superhero khas Korea, film ini menghadirkan kisah seru tentang kerja sama, keberanian, dan persahabatan.

programme.title: Smugglers
programme.desc: Para wanita penyelam mengalami kesulitan untuk mengumpulkan boga bahari karena adanya pabrik yang baru saja dibangun. Untuk menyambung hidup, mereka mulai melakukan bisnis penyelundupan.

programme.title: Montage
programme.desc: 15 tahun yang lalu, seorang ibu kehilangan anaknya dalam kasus penculikan. Kejahatan serupa terjadi lagi dan kali ini dia tidak akan membiarkannya pergi.

programme.title: The Tiger
programme.desc: Saat Kerajaan Korea berada di bawah pendudukan Jepang, seorang pemburu tua dan berpengalaman ditantang oleh perburuan harimau terakhir.

programme.title: The Hot-Blooded
programme.desc: Empat sekawan berhenti Taekwondo dan berpisah usai diminta untuk kalah dengan sengaja dalam sebuah uji coba. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, mereka memutuskan untuk menghadapi geng lokal saat kampung halaman mereka terancam.

programme.title: 6/45: Lucky Lotto (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Kegembiraan karena menang lotre tak berlangsung lama bagi sersan Chun-woo sebab secara tak sengaja tiket lotre tersebut melintasi Garis Demarkasi Militer. Ia harus mengendalikan dirinya dan menemukan jalan keluar!

programme.title: The Girl On A Bulldozer (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang gadis tinggal bersama ayah dan seorang saudara kandung. Suatu hari, ayahnya mengalami kecelakaan misterius, yang memaksanya untuk merawat adik perempuannya, mengelola restoran, dan membantu seorang penyelidik untuk mengungkap kebenaran di balik kecelakaan tersebut.

programme.title: Killing Romance (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Hwang Yeo-Re diejek karena kemampuan aktingnya yang buruk, sehingga ia berhenti dari industri hiburan dan menikahi seorang pria kaya. Ketika pernikahan itu membuatnya menjadi tawanan di rumahnya sendiri, Hwang Yeo-Re memutuskan untuk kembali ke kehidupan lamanya dan meminta bantuan tetangganya yang ramah.

programme.title: Honeysweet
programme.desc: Chi-ho adalah seorang perancang produk nan sukses, sementara Il-young bekerja di suatu perusahaan pinjaman. Mereka bertemu saat Chi-ho mencoba membayar hutang kakaknya. Kebetulan membuat mereka menjadi dekat.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: As a child, Phil Weston (Will Ferrell) was never able to live up to the demands of his overbearing father, Buck (Robert Duvall), who wanted Phil to be an athlete. Now a parent himself, Phil has inherited his father's competitive nature, while his son, Sam (Dylan McLaughlin), has inherited Phil's lack of athletic talent. Serving as Sam's soccer coach, Phil hopes to turn his last-place team of losers into champions, so they can beat the rival team coached by Buck.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 EP02 Blue Birthday [English Dub]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Under My Skin
programme.desc: Denny, a free spirit and artist falls for Ryan, a strait-laced lawyer. When Denny questions gender their love is tested. Denny is played by four different actors, exploring four chapters in their story.

programme.title: Where The Rivers Flow North
programme.desc: Log driver Noel Lord defies power company boss Clayton Farnsworth, who orders Lord and his feisty American Indian mate off their soon-to-be-flooded land. Farnsworth never met a man he couldn't buy - but then, he'd never met Noel Lord.

programme.title: Kung Fu Brother
programme.desc: Three cops and a reporter pursue a murderer who's hellbent on acquiring sacred scrolls. As they chase the murderer far and wide, they must find a way to take him down before he gets his hands on the scrolls.

programme.title: Iceman: Book One
programme.desc: Known as Iceman, a newly retired organized crime fixer is pulled back deeper than ever.

programme.title: All I Want Is You
programme.desc: After holding her man down on a long 4-year bid, Chloe is ready to risk it all when another woman tries to steal her man.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Badland
programme.desc: A young soldier unable to process the horrors of war he experienced in Iraq, returns home only to commit his own horrors.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: The Real Blonde
programme.desc: An aspiring actor (Matthew Modine) and his girlfriend (Catherine Keener) handle life's frustrations, while his friend seeks fulfillment with a blonde (Daryl Hannah).

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow
programme.desc: A Hong Kong policeman blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve (Steven McQueen) and his best girl, Jane (Aneta Corseaut), as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man and grow to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave (Earl Rowe) refuses to believe the kids without proof.

programme.title: Chopper
programme.desc: America had Al Capone; England, the Kray brothers and Australia - proving once and for all its antipodean sense of humor - has Mark "Chopper" Read. "Chopper" is inspired by the books of Mark Brandon "Chopper" Read, arguably Australia's most infamous former criminal. "Chopper" draws on police records, court transcripts, news coverage and interviews with people who knew Chopper Read.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: Murder Legendre is the menacingly named zombie master of Haiti. Charles Beaumont goes to him when he needs help for a twisted plan. Spurned in marriage by Madeline Short, Beaumont has decided on a simple solution: kill Short and bring her back as a zombie. Then he can be with her forever. The only problem comes when Legendre keeps the fetching girl for himself -- and her new husband comes to Madeline's rescue.

programme.title: The BeastMaster
programme.desc: A psychic (Marc Singer) saves a slave girl (Tanya Roberts) from a sorcerer (Rip Torn).

programme.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
programme.desc: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

programme.title: Her Smell
programme.desc: Becky Something is a talented but self-destructive musician who seems determined to alienate everyone around her -- even at the cost of her own band's success.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

programme.title: Cobra Verde
programme.desc: Francisco Manoel da Silva (Klaus Kinski) plays an enterprising young Brazilian who, after impregnating the three daughters of his plantation-owning employer, is sent to West Africa to round up slaves. Francisco goes to great lengths to befriend the very people he hopes to enslave -- eventually managing to overthrow a mad monarch and set himself up as king.

programme.title: A Boy and His Dog
programme.desc: Vic is a libidinous 18-year-old traversing the post-apocalyptic desert of 2024, in the company of his telepathic dog, Blood. When the pair encounter an underground community, the leader's daughter, Quilla Holmes, seduces Vic into their fold, separating him from Blood, who's left to survive on his own. But once Vic discovers he's been lured there solely for mechanized procreation, he realizes he's doomed unless he can escape and rejoin Blood.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

programme.title: Yakuza Wolf 2
programme.desc: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: Inquisitive journalist Grace Collier (Jennifer Salt) is horrified when she witnesses her neighbor, fashion model Danielle Breton (Margot Kidder), violently murder a man. Panicking, she calls the police. But when the detective arrives at the scene and finds nothing amiss, Grace is forced to take matters into her own hands. Her first move is to recruit private investigator Joseph Larch (Charles Durning), who helps her to uncover a secret about Danielle's past that has them both seeing double.

programme.title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
programme.desc: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

programme.title: The Grey
programme.desc: Following a grueling five-week shift at an Alaskan oil refinery, workers led by sharpshooter John Ottway are flying home for a much-needed vacation. A brutal storm causes their plane to crash in the frozen wilderness, and only eight men, including Ottway, survive. As they trek southward toward civilization and safety, Ottway and his companions must battle mortal injuries, the icy elements, and a pack of hungry wolves.

programme.title: Blind Horizon
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Murderball
programme.desc: This documentary introduces the U.S. quad rugby team -- a team composed entirely of young paraplegic men. Using special wheelchairs and very little protection, the players play full-contact competitive rugby, using rules only slightly altered to accommodate their limitations. The film follows the team as they discuss the sport, their lives, and how they ended up in their chairs to begin with, while they play their way to the 2004 Paralympic Games in Athens, Greece.

programme.title: Prison on Fire 2
programme.desc: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

programme.title: Homeboy
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergrass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Warrior's Way
programme.desc: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, master swordsman Yang (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town. He puts away his sword for good, vowing to raise the baby in peace. Yang befriends Lynne, a woman who wants revenge against a colonel, the man who murdered her family. When the colonel returns to wreak havoc on the town, Yang draws his sword to protect his new friends, but the sound of fighting draws Yang's murderous clansmen into the fray as well.

programme.title: Knight of Cups
programme.desc: A Los Angeles screenwriter (Christian Bale) indulges his wild side with a stripper (Teresa Palmer), a model (Freida Pinto) and a married woman (Natalie Portman).

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: The Blackwater Lightship
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Colm Toibin, The Blackwater Lightship tells the compelling story of reconciliation between three generations of women whose relations have been marked by decades of misunderstandings.

programme.title: Journey
programme.desc: In this drama based on a novel by Patricia MacLachlan, 11-year-old Journey is heartbroken when his mother, Min, skips town, leaving him and his sister, Cat, alone. Then they are sent to live on the family farm with their grandmother Lottie and grandfather Marcus. It's a difficult transition, but over time Journey gets used to his new life, especially when Marcus helps him develop an interest in photography.

Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.desc: Detective Huang Mingjin faces off against criminal mastermind Wei Yunzhou in a city plagued by dark secrets. As police and criminals flood the streets, Huang must unravel the city's sinister core while engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with Wei.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: A street fighter in Northeast China decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City, but he's implicated in fights and conspiracies among triad forces.

programme.title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
programme.desc: One year after avenging his brother's murder, MMA champion Kurt Sloane finds himself imprisoned by a powerful gangster in Thailand. To win back his freedom, he must train for a fight against a 400-pound killer in an underground death match.

programme.title: Memories of the Sword
programme.desc: A warrior goes on a mission to seek revenge for the death of her parents.

programme.title: Ip Man: The Awakening
programme.desc: After stopping a kidnapping, a young Ip Man becomes the target of a human trafficking ring and must face the group's brutal boxing champion head-on.

programme.title: The Unity of Heroes
programme.desc: A martial artist battles zombielike foes who are impervious to pain.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: This sequel focuses on ex-police officer Brian O'Conner (Paul Walker), who relocates from Los Angeles to Miami to start over. Becoming involved in the street-racing scene in his new city, Brian befriends car-savvy Tej (Chris "Ludacris" Bridges) and Suki (Devon Aoki), but his competitive streak ends when federal agents apprehend him, and he must enter into a deal with the FBI. Working with new partner Roman Pearce (Tyrese), Brian begins a dangerous mission to take down a powerful drug dealer.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Since Dom (Vin Diesel) and Brian's (Paul Walker) heist in Rio left them and their crew very rich people, they've scattered across the globe; however, they must still live as fugitives, unable to return home to their families. Meanwhile, Agent Hobbs (Dwayne Johnson) has been tracking a gang of lethally skilled mercenary drivers whose second-in-command is someone Dom knows. Unable to take them down himself, Hobbs asks Dom and his crew for help in exchange for full pardons for everyone.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Welcome to Sudden Death
programme.desc: A security guard battles a group of tech-savvy terrorists after they take hostages inside a basketball arena.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: Kicking & Screaming
programme.desc: As a child, Phil Weston (Will Ferrell) was never able to live up to the demands of his overbearing father, Buck (Robert Duvall), who wanted Phil to be an athlete. Now a parent himself, Phil has inherited his father's competitive nature, while his son, Sam (Dylan McLaughlin), has inherited Phil's lack of athletic talent. Serving as Sam's soccer coach, Phil hopes to turn his last-place team of losers into champions, so they can beat the rival team coached by Buck.

programme.title: Hot Fuzz
programme.desc: As a former London constable, Nicholas Angel (Simon Pegg) finds it difficult to adapt to his new assignment in the sleepy British village of Sandford. Not only does he miss the excitement of the big city, but he also has a well-meaning oaf (Nick Frost) for a partner. However, when a series of grisly accidents rocks Sandford, Nick smells something rotten in the idyllic village.

programme.title: The Boss
programme.desc: Wealthy CEO Michelle Darnell (Melissa McCarthy) always gets her way, until she's busted for insider trading and sent to federal prison. After leaving jail, Darnell finds herself broke, homeless and hated. Luckily, she tracks down former assistant Claire (Kristen Bell), the only person who's willing to help. While staying with Claire and her young daughter, the ex-con devises a new business model for a brownie empire. Unfortunately, some old enemies stand in the way of her return to the top.

programme.title: Admission
programme.desc: When straight-laced Princeton University admissions officer Portia Nathan (Tina Fey) pays a recruiting visit to an alternative high school, she receives some news that catches her way off-guard. John Pressman (Paul Rudd), head of the school and Portia's former college classmate, has surmised that his student, Jeremiah, is the son that Portia secretly gave up for adoption. Portia puts her career at risk by bending the rules for Jeremiah but also discovers a life and romance she never imagined.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her
programme.desc: When a novelist loses her man to a movie star and former friend, she winds up in a psychiatric hospital. Years later, she returns home to confront the now-married couple, looking radiant. Her ex-husband's new wife wants to know her secret, and discovers that she has been taking a mysterious drug which grants eternal life to the person who drinks it. The actress follows suit, but discovers that immortality has a price.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Nurse Betty
programme.desc: What happens when a person decides that life is merely a state of mind? If you're Betty, a small-town waitress and soap opera fan from Fair Oaks, Kansas, you refuse to believe that you can't be with the love of your life just because he doesn't really exist. After all, life is no excuse for not living. Traumatized by a savage event, Betty enters into a fugue state that allows -- even encourages -- her to keep functioning... in a kind of alternate reality.

programme.title: Cookie's Fortune
programme.desc: After learning that her aunt, an elderly Mississippi widow (Patricia Neal), has taken her own life, Camille (Glenn Close) hatches an unusual postmortem plan. With her sister (Julianne Moore) in tow, Camille hides evidence that points to suicide, deciding instead to make the death look like a murder. Her scheme, fueled by vanity and greed, is not victimless, as it appears that a local handyman (Charles S. Dutton) might take the fall for a crime that never occurred.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her
programme.desc: When a novelist loses her man to a movie star and former friend, she winds up in a psychiatric hospital. Years later, she returns home to confront the now-married couple, looking radiant. Her ex-husband's new wife wants to know her secret, and discovers that she has been taking a mysterious drug which grants eternal life to the person who drinks it. The actress follows suit, but discovers that immortality has a price.

programme.title: Mamma Mia!Here We Go Again
programme.desc: In 1979 young Donna, Tanya and Rosie graduate from Oxford University -- leaving Donna free to embark on a series of adventures throughout Europe. On her journeys, she makes the acquaintances of Harry, Bill and Sam -- the latter whom she falls in love with, but he's also the man who breaks her heart. In the present day, Donna's pregnant daughter, Sophie, dreams of renovating a taverna while reuniting with her mother's old friends and boyfriends on the Greek island of Kalokairi.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. programme.title: Cry Wolf
programme.desc: Mysterious murders occur when students (Lindy Booth, Julian Morris) at a prep school invent a story about a serial killer.

programme.title: The Watcher
programme.desc: The Watcher is an exciting psychological thriller that takes a unique look into the minds of both a serial killer and the man who must, reluctantly, pursue him. In an almost Hitchcockian way, the film quickly introduces us to the killer, David Allen Griffin, played by Keanu Reeves, who for many years, preyed on lonely young women in the Los Angeles area. The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). When a malevolent alien presence begins killing off the crew, navigator Kit Foster (Jamie Lee Curtis) tries to convince the rest of them to leave before it's too late.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put the Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi's heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his star chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Tea bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra star chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba's soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people's minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus's Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba's soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus's secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus's glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Law vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bellamy escapes Doflamingo's control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle Against the Executives! Proud Hajrudin!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Lao G and Don Chinjao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Love! The New Leader Sai vs. Baby 5!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!
programme.sub-title: The Man's Pride! Bellamy's Last Charge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger's horrible true nature!
programme.sub-title: A Strong Wind and a Surge! Hakuba vs. Dellinger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bartolomeo is in a neck-and-neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Princess Mansherry's amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who've gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor's tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!
programme.sub-title: The Manly Duel! Señor's Elegy of Love!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner's sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess.
programme.sub-title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kyros, unbowed by Diamante's vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
programme.sub-title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King's Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
programme.sub-title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy's hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
programme.sub-title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Law's attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo's power has depths which he and Luffy haven't bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
programme.sub-title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trebol's wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
programme.sub-title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trebol!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren't working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
programme.sub-title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy's Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people: Survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bounce-man's power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment.
programme.sub-title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats' allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
programme.sub-title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry's powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!
programme.sub-title: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
programme.sub-title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!
